bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 29.6K on Instagram, and seven weeks of mentorship for $500.
beats.text: Your mentorship fills from a Telegram post and a JotForm: $250 to hold a spot, $250 when it starts. One-on-one time is $100 an hour. The demand is there. The sales process and the pricing haven't caught up with it.

beats.title: 1,700 people read your Telegram. The mentorship still sells in a single post.
beats.text: You run a small-group mentorship every seven weeks, and in August three spots were filled and two left from a single post. That's warm demand going through a waitlist form with no page, no call and no follow-up in between.

beats.title: 4 of the 7 links on your bio page lead nowhere.
beats.text: On your Komi page, the pre-recorded course opens a Teachable school with no products, and all three ebooks point to havemercitrades.store, a domain that no longer exists. Your YouTube description still sends people to havemercitrades.com, which shows a closed store.

stats.label: links on your Komi page that don't open
ebooks on a domain that no longer exists

beats.title: “My community and my form already work.” They stay.
beats.text: Mighty Networks stays your community and the application still asks what you ask today. The difference is one official page with your application, a call, and pre-call emails, so people know exactly where the real HaveMerciTrades is and never pay through a DM.
beats.quote: “There are A lot of fake tik tok accounts going around of me so please be aware!!”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You know the concepts, not the process
cards.body: You've watched the order block videos. At the open you still don't know which setup to take, or when to sit on your hands.

cards.title: You overtrade, then revenge trade
cards.body: One loss turns into three. It isn't a strategy problem. It's a discipline problem, and nobody is holding you to a plan.

cards.title: You're learning alone next to a 9-to-5
cards.body: Limited time, no one to review your trades, and no structure that fits around your job.

mechanism.title: Structured trading is simple trading
mechanism.body: One market, one clear A+ setup and fixed risk. Over seven weeks you learn to read Nasdaq with order blocks and liquidity, trade the New York open with a plan, and journal every trade, with faith and discipline instead of pressure.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.previewText: Your call with Merci is confirmed
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think about where you are: how long you've been trading, what you trade, and what keeps going wrong.

One important note: there are fake accounts using my name. I will never ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Merci

preCallEmails.subject: Overtrading isn't a strategy problem
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders don't lose because their strategy is bad. They lose because they take trades their plan never allowed: after a loss, out of boredom, or to "finish the week strong".

That's why the mentorship starts with structure: one market, one A+ setup, fixed risk and a journal.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Merci

preCallEmails.subject: "I work a 9-to-5. Can I really do this?"
preCallEmails.previewText: Short answer: that's who it's built for
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

You don't need perfect timing, you need commitment.

The mentorship is seven weeks, one topic a week, with homework you can do around your job. What matters is that you show up and do the work.

If the timing doesn't work for you right now, we'll tell you so on the call.

Merci

preCallEmails.subject: What the call is (and isn't)
preCallEmails.previewText: No signals, no promises, just a straight conversation
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

So you know what to expect:

- The call takes about 20 to 30 minutes.
- We'll talk about your experience, your goals and what's been holding you back.
- If the mentorship fits, I'll explain how it works and the investment.
- If it doesn't, I'll tell you and point you to the free resources.

What the call isn't: no signals, no trade calls, no promises of profits. Trading involves substantial risk of loss.

Merci

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Merci
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

Quick checklist:
- A quiet place and a stable connection
- A few recent trades or your journal, if you have one
- Your questions

Need to reschedule? {{reschedule_link}}

Merci

preCallEmails.subject: Today at {{call_time}}
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Today's the day. Your call is at {{call_time}}.

Join here: {{meeting_link}}

See you there,
Merci
